Divides the ground-state energy by four
Doubles the ground-state energy

questions.hint: Use E_n = n squared h squared over 8 m L squared with n = 1.

questions.explanation: The transition energy is Delta E = (2^2 - 1^2) E1 = 1.53 eV, so the emitted wavelength is hc/Delta E = 812.9 nm. Using E1 alone, multiplying hc by Delta E, or halving the wavelength all fail to use the level difference correctly.
questions.hint: Take the difference of n squared times E1, then divide 1240 by it.
